UK to refuel Saudi jets against Houthi attacks

The United Kingdom will provide aerial refuelling to Saudi Arabia to help counter attacks by Houthi forces. This support aims to bolster Saudi Arabia's defence against strikes attributed to Iran-backed Houthis. Leaders of the G7 nations have also condemned Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia.
